# #1844: Patch: the AI at the wheel: a bounded autopilot, the Pareto hint and a free helpful action
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Phase 0 of the Stinkyscape set: a mechanic merged on `main` without the set. No card reaches it until fullsend 1 ships the set; its Stinkyscape cards are built later, in S12.

## The rule

The autopilot (R1183002) as an aura: the first N actions of each of your turns (Stinkyscape #46 Circadian Halfcycler, 3), or whole turns (#47 Circadian Fullcycler); the Pareto judge (ME-PARETO, Meditative #71) shown to a player as a hint, the best action lit up, read from their own view only (#147 IN33DH3); and a free helpful action at the start of turn, a Zephrys-style pick cast at no cost (#147.2 Wardrum Blob).

## Done when

- The rule is an engine primitive (`crates/engine`), proved on fixture scripts (`crates/engine/tests/rules/fixtures/`, the `testkit`'s `scenario()`), its edges included. No Stinkyscape card is needed or added: the cards come later, behind the set's gate.

- A new event has its `ANIMATIONS` and `SOUND_CUES` rows; a new prompt or action is answered by `crates/ai`, the random policy and the timeout, and `legalActions`, the reducer's refusal and the view agree.
- The client's piece, where the mechanic has one, renders `viewFor` alone (CLAUDE.md rule 7): here the hint.
- New state is optional and skipped when absent, so no shipped game changes: no golden trace moves and `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main` names no card that plays differently (plan D3).
- Every number is a named constant (CLAUDE.md rule 9) and the pure crates stay pure (rule 4).
- The gates: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts`, `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `patches check`, `spec check`, `fuzz --seeds 200`, and the web's typecheck and tests where the client changed.

The plan: [`docs/stinkyscape-set.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/stoic-planck-f1rvyy/docs/stinkyscape-set.md) (ST3, ST5); the designer's list: [`JackiOh_Stinkyscape_Cards.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/stoic-planck-f1rvyy/JackiOh_Stinkyscape_Cards.md). Both are on the planning branch `claude/stoic-planck-f1rvyy` until they merge; where they disagree with SPEC, SPEC wins (CLAUDE.md).

**Rule and decisions (the notes' text).**

- **R1844000, the autopilot aura:**
  - It engages as each of your turns begins, and `due` reads the aura again before every step.
  - A count takes R456's actions: a play or an attack. An answer belongs to the action that asked, so the autopilot answers the prompt that its last counted action opened. Then it hands the turn back and clears the status.
  - A whole-turn aura plays as Cognitive Offloading does, `AUTOPILOT_MAX_ACTIONS` and the timeout included.
  - A whole turn beats any count. Among counts the largest holds; they never add up.
  - A card that arrives mid-turn waits for your next turn.
  - Cognitive Offloading played on an aura turn takes the rest of that turn whole. This revises R1183002 for that case.
  - Rejected:
    - R1183003's count, where answers count.
    - Engaging only at the main phase, which would leave start-of-turn prompts to the player.
- **R1844001, the Pareto hint:**
  - The verb works on its caster's own turn only, until cleanup. The aura works on each of its controller's turns.
  - It covers plays only. It marks the cards that the judge (R1125) would call optimal, scored on the player's concealed copy, with ties sharing the mark. So a hinted play never sets off an opposing Pareto Optimality.
  - Only the player's own view carries it. Watchers of that seat and a Duos teammate see it, just as they see that hand.
  - Rejected: the autopilot's `choose`, which also covers attacks and End turn.
- **R1844002, the helpful cast:**
  - It ranks the pool the way C+ #27 does and casts the top card. Per R70 the cast is free, counts as a play, and the caster picks the targets.
  - `radiant` ranks Radiant faces and casts the pick Radiant.
  - Outside its player's main phase, such as at the start of a turn, the scorer ranks on printed data, as §10.7 always does there.
  - Rejected: a Zephrys Discover.
- The count uses no declared number (R386).

**Rule and decisions (the notes' text).**

- **R1844000, the autopilot aura:**
  - It engages as each of your turns begins, and `due` reads the aura again before every step.
  - A count takes R456's actions: a play or an attack. An answer belongs to the action that asked, so the autopilot answers the prompt that its last counted action opened. Then it hands the turn back and clears the status.
  - A whole-turn aura plays as Cognitive Offloading does, `AUTOPILOT_MAX_ACTIONS` and the timeout included.
  - A whole turn beats any count. Among counts the largest holds; they never add up.
  - A card that arrives mid-turn waits for your next turn.
  - Cognitive Offloading played on an aura turn takes the rest of that turn whole. This revises R1183002 for that case.
  - Rejected:
    - R1183003's count, where answers count.
    - Engaging only at the main phase, which would leave start-of-turn prompts to the player.
- **R1844001, the Pareto hint:**
  - The verb works on its caster's own turn only, until cleanup. The aura works on each of its controller's turns.
  - It covers plays only. It marks the cards that the judge (R1125) would call optimal, scored on the player's concealed copy, with ties sharing the mark. So a hinted play never sets off an opposing Pareto Optimality.
  - Only the player's own view carries it. Watchers of that seat and a Duos teammate see it, just as they see that hand.
  - Rejected: the autopilot's `choose`, which also covers attacks and End turn.
- **R1844002, the helpful cast:**
  - It ranks the pool the way C+ #27 does and casts the top card. Per R70 the cast is free, counts as a play, and the caster picks the targets.
  - `radiant` ranks Radiant faces and casts the pick Radiant.
  - Outside its player's main phase, such as at the start of a turn, the scorer ranks on printed data, as §10.7 always does there.
  - Rejected: a Zephrys Discover.
- The count uses no declared number (R386).
